entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?

Hi Charlie... *sigh* I'm calling about an order. I bought some cycling shoes a little while ago and... they're just not working out. I feel so bad about it, but I really need to see if I can return them.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't working for you. I can definitely look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF77194. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was so excited for these. It's just really disappointing.

Thank you, I've got the order pulled up. I see the Velo-Carbon cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a fit and preference issue?

It's the fit. They're just... painful. I've tried adjusting the cleats in every possible position, worn different socks, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I just can't wear them, and honestly, I really needed this money back for other things. It was a big purchase for me.
I understand completely. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see here you received the item 57 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long already? I feel terrible. I just kept trying to make them work, hoping they'd break in. I really hope it's not too late.

No worries at all. Let's see... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I am emailing a pre-paid return label to the address on file as we speak.
Oh, you can? That's such a relief! Thank you so, so much, Charlie. I was so worried I was just stuck with them. You have no idea what a help this is.

Of course. We want you to be happy with your gear. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, you've been wonderful.
You're very welcome. Have a great day.
